summary.name: Verand
summary.one_liner: Verand is an AI SEO platform for regulated businesses that writes articles from your expertise, checks them against industry compliance rules before publishing, and tracks Google rankings and mentions in AI assistant answers.
use_cases: Writing SEO articles for regulated firms
Checking marketing claims against industry rules before publishing
Tracking Google rankings for a business
Monitoring how AI assistants mention your brand versus competitors
Reviewing disclaimers and banned claims in financial, legal, medical or insurance content
summary.what_it_does: The page describes articles written in a brand's voice from its own expertise, with each draft checked against industry rules before approval. A compliance gate reads the finished HTML and returns Pass or Blocked, flagging specific sentences such as guaranteed outcomes or unsupported return figures, and suggests fixes. Industry packs for areas such as US SEC RIA advisers, Reg D syndication, attorneys, CPAs, medical/HIPAA practices and insurance are referenced, each with a governing body and required disclaimer. It also tracks visibility, share of voice, average position, sentiment and citations across AI assistants and Google for a set of prompts and competitor brands. The page shows sample dashboards and includes 43 free tools that need no signup.
notable: Compliance gate that blocks non-compliant sentences before publishing, with industry rule packs
Tracks brand mentions, share of voice and sentiment across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI answers
43 free tools live with no signup
Prompt budget shared across sites on an account (e.g. 200 prompts on an Agency plan)
caveats: Rules are researched by Verand and not reviewed by a licensed attorney; users must have counsel confirm applicability
Canadian regulator packs are listed as on the roadmap
Listing tags it as paid, and the page shows plan-based prompt limits
